features.name: Rename and reorganise stored items
features.description: Patches titles and folder parents under graph validation and lock checks, including validation of a destination folder.
limits: Records retain table ownership. Moving a folder into itself or its descendants is rejected.

features.name: Document-only recents
features.description: open_item deduplicates and prepends a document in recents, caps the list and removes trashed items.
limits: Up to 100 active pages, tables or records; no folder entries or automatic filesystem recents. Opening is a revision-changing write.

features.name: Stable internal links across interchange
features.description: Native #workspace/<id> fragment references survive sanitised content, Markdown and full backup with stable identifiers.
limits: Links are inert references, not ownership grants; missing targets remain unavailable rather than failing graph validation.

features.name: Five basic typed properties
features.description: Validates text, finite bounded numbers, booleans, real ISO calendar dates and configured single-select values. Missing/null values are supported.
limits: Unknown properties and wrong types refuse. Text limit 20000 characters, numbers bounded by absolute 1e15, select options limited to 100.

features.name: Column schema and atomic row revalidation
features.description: Adds/removes/reorders columns through whole-schema replacement, enforces unique IDs/names and unambiguous references, prunes removed values and revalidates surviving row data atomically.
limits: No automatic coercion for incompatible type changes. Up to 100 stored columns even where CSV parser admits more.

features.name: Cross-table record relations
features.description: Relation properties contain bounded unique IDs of records in a declared Workspace table; invalid ownership or references refuse.
limits: Up to 1000 related record IDs per value. Relations are local to one Store graph, not cross-private/shared-space links. No rollups or automatic reciprocal relation columns.

features.name: Relation Trash and purge integrity
features.description: Trashing preserves existing relation references but prevents newly linking trashed targets. Purge removes dead record references, target-table relation columns and dependent formulas under affected-item locks.
limits: Purge also adjusts historical schemas and templates, so it is not limited to deleting the visible target row.

features.name: Bounded same-row formula language
features.description: Supports literals, column IDs/names, col(), arithmetic + - * / %, comparisons, Boolean operations and lazy conditional expressions/IF.
limits: No eval, arbitrary code, object access, indexing, exponentiation, cross-row reads or rollups. Source 1024 characters, 128 AST nodes and depth 20.

features.name: Scalar formula functions
features.description: Provides abs, round, min, max, len, lower, upper, concat and coalesce with bounded scalar inputs and output.
limits: Text results capped at 10000 characters, numeric magnitude at 1e15 and round precision from -15 to 15. Coalesce evaluates its arguments; only IF/conditional branches are lazy.

features.name: Dependency chains and authoritative results
features.description: Validates references and rejects formula cycles/deep dependencies; computes values server-side and exposes null plus formula_errors on computation failure.
limits: Computed values cannot be client-written. Formula results and errors are projections, not persisted writable properties; relation arrays are not scalar formula operands.

features.name: Sorting and filtering
features.description: Derives visible table rows by case-insensitive substring filtering across title/property strings and ascending/descending sort by title or a property.
limits: Client-side view state, not a saved query/schema feature. Numeric comparator is specialised to number columns; other values use string comparison.

features.name: Select-grouped boards
features.description: Select-grouped boards derive lanes from the same saved record properties. Latest source uses null for no value, separate from literal Unassigned, and per-lane creation writes the selected property.
limits: View/group configuration remains client-local; no independent board schema, automations or embedded live views.
Installed bundle still groups empty values and a real Unassigned option together and creates records generically, not per lane. Working generated bundle also predates latest null-sentinel source fix.
No data/model execution performed; UI lane-creation support must not be promoted to installed/native acceptance.

features.name: Page and record template snapshots
features.description: Captures reusable page or record content and editable properties. Record templates include the source schema and require exact compatible columns at application.
limits: Copies data, not comments, native runs or thread identity. No database/folder templates, template editing or deletion command is exposed.

features.name: Independent template attachments
features.description: Templates copy attachment bytes and remap fresh attachment IDs on application, so they remain usable after the source page is purged.
limits: Stored template and copied assets share the whole Store size/count limits.

features.name: Durable comments, replies and target references
features.description: Stores page/record text anchors or whole-item feedback, separate user/agent replies, explicit resolved state and structured related-item IDs.
limits: Tables accept whole-database comments only; no cell/folder comments. Text targets are data references, not edit authority; author labels are user/agent rather than a shared-member audit identity.

features.name: Derived anchor attachment and deletion tombstones
features.description: Anchor quote/prefix/suffix derives attached versus detached status. Deleting feedback removes its text/replies while preserving a hidden provenance tombstone.
limits: Deleted comments are hidden from display snapshots and cannot be reopened or replied to. Repeated or absent passage matches detach rather than guessing.

features.name: Local literal text search
features.description: Casefolded substring matching covers page/table/record titles, plain document text and string-valued record/formula properties; excludes folders and Trash.
limits: No semantic/vector search, attachment-body indexing or comments search. Legacy search returns only the first 200 matching full item projections.

features.name: Paged summaries and stable search revisions
features.description: search_page returns lightweight IDs/kinds/titles/excerpts with total, offset, next_offset and has_more; further pages require the same saved revision.
limits: Page size 1 to 200. No index; graph and formula computation occur on each read. Shared command route does not expose search_page.

features.name: Cascade Trash without expiry
features.description: Trashing a folder or table includes its descendants/records and removes their recents; pre-existing independently trashed children keep their own group.
limits: No automatic expiry path is present in the inspected Store; Trash is not a full copy and continues consuming the store budget.

features.name: Hierarchy-aware restoration
features.description: Restores the selected Trash group while preserving previously independent deletions; requires a live parent folder/table before child restore.
limits: Backup replacement reconstructs Trash grouping from hierarchy/timestamps. Restore is not an implicit permanent-delete undo.

features.name: Explicit permanent purge with reference repair
features.description: Purges only trashed item hierarchies and owned data; prunes related run/comment/history/template references and checks all affected locks.
limits: References to purged data are deliberately rewritten or removed. No automatic expiry, purge of active items or automatic purge recovery.

features.name: Stored original and user attachment bytes
features.description: Stores item-owned filename, media type and base64 bytes with stable IDs, validating filename shape, MIME syntax and decoded size.
limits: 1000 attachment entries and 10000000 decoded bytes each, further constrained by state/HTTP budgets. No external path attachment input or standalone attachment-delete REST command.

features.name: Attachment references and survivor repair
features.description: Validates content/history references and carries referenced assets on document/history reads; owner purge copies still-referenced assets to surviving documents and rewrites their URIs.
limits: Cross-item references can exist within one Store. Converter exports require supplied item-owned raster bytes, so not every admitted cross-item image reference exports unchanged.

features.name: Deliberate local file import API
features.description: POST /import accepts a display filename and base64 payload, converts before committing, then atomically creates a page plus original or table plus records.
limits: No file path, automatic folder ingestion, remote conversion service or native execution from imported data. Private-store route only.

features.name: Markdown page import
features.description: Parses bounded Markdown headings, basic marks/links, nested lists/checklists, quotes, code fences and simple pipe tables into sanitised editable HTML, retaining original bytes.
limits: UTF-8 with optional BOM; bounded common syntax, not full CommonMark or exact document round-trip. Raw active HTML is not passed through.

features.name: Markdown document export
features.description: Exports semantic document content to UTF-8 Markdown with native fragment links, inline marks, lists/tasks, code, quotes, tables and image references.
limits: Lossy interchange, not a full backup. Rich layout, some semantic marks, properties, comments and recovery history are not represented as complete data.

features.name: UTF-8 CSV table import
features.description: Requires unique nonempty headers, correct row widths and quoted CSV syntax; preserves every value as text and creates a table with row documents.
limits: No type guessing or original CSV attachment. Parser caps 256 columns/10000 rows/128 KiB source bytes per cell, but Store caps 100 columns, 5000 total items and 20000-character text properties.

features.name: Spreadsheet-safe CSV export
features.description: Exports current table schema names and active record property values as UTF-8 CSV; list/object values use JSON text and computed projections can be exported.
limits: Prefixes formula-like nonnumeric text by default, intentionally changing interchange text. No record-body/comment/history fidelity or preservation of typed schema.

features.name: Editable DOCX import with originals
features.description: DOCX import retains the original bytes and extracts supported semantic content. Working now groups contiguous list paragraphs, nests lists up to depth 8, tracks numbering identities/starts/continuations/restarts/overrides, and decodes Word line breaks/tabs as code whitespace for Code-style paragraphs. Installed retains the prior importer.
limits: Working-only improvements: installed interchange.py is byte-identical to the previous installed and previous working baseline, so installed lists are still emitted as isolated flat one-item lists and Code-style br/tab handling is still the older conversion.

Neither variant reconstructs arbitrary Word style/layout fidelity, original pagination, drawings, headers, footnotes, floating objects or tracked-change history. Legacy .doc and OCR are unsupported. Original attachments do not make omitted image content editable.

Working numbered formats are reduced to ordered versus bullet categories rather than preserving every Word numbering glyph/template; stylesheet-derived numbering is not generally resolved. New regression source was read, not executed.

features.name: Real DOCX semantic export
features.description: Real semantic DOCX export remains present in both variants. Working adds independent numbering identities per HTML list, list start overrides, and explicit Word br/tab elements for preformatted newline/tab content. Installed retains the older list numbering and preformatted-text exporter.
limits: Working-only list/start/code-whitespace changes are not in the installed package. New source fixtures are not executed round-trip evidence.
Newly generated layout, fixed page/style defaults, no tracked changes/page-layout controls or exact import fidelity. Simple table support does not imply arbitrary rich nested table/list equivalence.

features.name: Text-PDF import
features.description: Extracts supported PDF page text in source-page order to editable HTML with source-page headings and retains original bytes.
limits: No OCR. Encrypted, no-text, image-only and mixed image-only pages refuse. No reconstruction of columns, layout, tables, embedded images or original text styling.

features.name: Readable PDF export
features.description: Both variants generate newly laid-out readable PDFs. Working additionally styles top-level code with Courier/background and quotes with italic/indentation, and splits table-cell content into ordered text and byte-backed raster image flowables. Installed retains older body-style code/quote rendering and table-cell image placeholders.
limits: Working PDF table-cell raster embedding and code/quote styles are absent from installed interchange.py. Film only the package actually demonstrated; do not advertise these as installed.

Source implements bounded raster scaling and semantic text order, not arbitrary original PDF/Word layout or typography fidelity. New cell text rendering does not promise complete block-style fidelity within cells.
Latin uses embedded fonts; CJK relies on a standard reader CID font; complex shaping/RTL not promised. Converter dependencies, real generated output, pagination and host runtime were not exercised.

features.name: Raster image export policy
features.description: Resolves item-owned attachment images or inline PNG/JPEG data, validates bounded rasters, embeds PNG/JPEG and converts GIF/WebP to the first frame.
limits: Never fetches remote images. 20000000-pixel and converter byte limits apply; malformed rasters refuse even Markdown export preparation. Converter ownership is stricter than generic in-store attachment references.

features.name: Semantic normal-weight compatibility
features.description: Preserves explicit normal-weight text nested inside a heading/bold ancestor via a narrow data-workspace-weight token across Store, DOCX and PDF.
limits: A single semantic token is supported, not arbitrary inline CSS or full Word style fidelity.

features.name: Bounded local converter execution
features.description: Applies byte/tree/archive/row/page limits before commit; PDF conversion runs in a child with a wall deadline and POSIX CPU/address-space bounds.
limits: Manifest pins converter dependencies; installation/availability not checked. PDF requires pypdf/reportlab, raster export needs Pillow. Non-POSIX resource behaviour and cross-platform fidelity remain unverified.

features.name: Archive and semantic input validation
features.description: Validates ZIP framing/member counts, paths, duplicate entries, compression ratios and actual bytes; DOCX rejects unsafe XML relationships/active package parts and strips nonsemantic HTML.
limits: These are static input-boundary implementations, not tested security guarantees or an OS sandbox. No probes were run.

features.name: Complete canonical Workspace archive
features.description: GET /backup builds a versioned ZIP containing canonical document/table graphs, comments/replies/anchors, attachments/originals, templates, recents, Trash and pre-run history.
limits: Full fidelity is scoped to Store categories. No native conversation history, installation/config, workflow grants/journal or shared catalog/member metadata. Source run records are archived but intentionally not restored.

features.name: Full-size backup transport budget
features.description: Full backups accept the Store 64000000-byte canonical raw snapshot budget independently of smaller document/converter limits and use an uncompressed ZIP member.
limits: Full archive/request envelope headroom differs from ordinary 8 MiB file import; all canonical per-category/graph limits still apply. No capacity test executed.

features.name: Version and digest checked archive validation
features.description: read_backup accepts only the complete version-1 snapshot envelope and validates its digest, JSON fields and canonical graph before any replacement.
limits: SHA-256 detects accidental corruption, not authenticity; archives are not encrypted or signed. Markdown/CSV and arbitrary ZIP files are not full backups.

features.name: Atomic whole-dataset replacement
features.description: Restore replaces rather than merges, preserves internal IDs/references, validates the complete graph and uses the receiving Store scope/revision. Active receiving runs block replacement.
limits: No automatic pre-replacement backup is created by this route. Capture/download a backup first. Omitted revision remains allowed in legacy noncompact calls.

features.name: Native identity detachment on restore
features.description: Clears thread IDs, executor selections, thread-owner references, run records and version run/thread references; rotates the section dataset epoch and retains receiving-store scope.
limits: Does not import foreign native session authority or resume runs. Section provenance remains historical data, not an execution grant.

features.name: Restore completion receipts and readback
features.description: Optional restore_id binds a scoped process-local receipt to the exact backup digest; repeated submissions return running/refused/committed/unknown state without repeating a known committed replacement.
limits: 64 process-local receipts, not durable recovery after backend restart. Missing receipt means unknown and must not trigger an automatic replacement retry; compact restore requires captured revision.

features.name: Saved version and typed schema restoration
features.description: Stored pre-run snapshots retain document content, title, properties and table schema; grouped table/record restore rehydrates old schema while visibly retaining incompatible later-row values in content.
limits: Discussion/resolution and current attachments are not rolled back. Not a general automatic version for every keystroke; native run/revert algorithms are inventoried separately.

features.name: Explicit-member local project data service
features.description: A separate local catalog and per-project Stores support multiple named shared projects while existing private profile stores remain untouched.
limits: Partial product wiring: service requires an approved server-supplied absolute application root; default production router does not supply one. No cloud account, public share URL or synchronisation.

features.name: Default editor and alternative read-only membership
features.description: Creation includes the creator as editor and adds only explicit member IDs. Omitted member role is editor; read_only permits viewing/search but no mutation.
limits: Application-level access, not isolation from same-user OS tools. Synthetic source tests only; deployed shared-storage composition remains unavailable.

features.name: Unlisted profiles have no project access
features.description: List queries join explicit membership and snapshots/commands check the authenticated profile before opening a project Store.
limits: Member identifiers are opaque keys derived from authenticated server profile homes, not browser-selected private-store paths. No implicit all-profile sharing.

features.name: Creator-managed member changes
features.description: Only the creating editor can add, change or remove members; the creator cannot remove or downgrade their own editor membership.
limits: No creator transfer, shared workspace rename/delete or project-role hierarchy beyond editor/read_only is exposed.

features.name: Membership revisions and revocation fencing
features.description: Mutations capture membership revision and Store revision/scope; the catalog write lock spans permission admission, Store waits and commit, so stale revoked/readded membership refuses.
limits: Serialised local writes are not simultaneous collaborative editing or sync. Existing durable run locks still apply.

features.name: Shared CRUD API composition seam
features.description: Routes expose shared project create/list/state/command/member-change and explicit private move, deriving actor from the admitted server profile rather than JSON.
limits: Production root is unset. Shared commands expose a bounded Store subset but no import/export/backup/history/catalog/paged-search route or workflow run route.

features.name: Confirmed atomic private-to-shared move
features.description: Moves only a chosen hierarchy in a dual-SQLite transaction with explicit confirmation, exact source/destination scopes and revisions and admitted editor membership.
limits: Same local filesystem, distinct Stores and ordinary rollback journals required. Root record move refuses: move its complete table. Native journals/grants and global templates do not move. No generic copy/sync or reverse move API.

features.name: Move reference and ownership preservation
features.description: Move transfers supported comments, attachments, versions, recents and contained run records, retaining original thread-owner provenance; graph validation refuses split dependencies/history.
limits: Cross-boundary relations, comment targets, referenced assets or split historical/active run scope refuse rather than pruning or widening. Retained native thread IDs do not make moved pages executable.

features.name: Exact local executor selection data
features.description: Validates and stores explicit executor profile/source/thread shape only via a trusted callback with captured revision. Shared binding requires caller and executor both to be editor members.
limits: Partial: a saved pair is inert data, never a native admission or grant. No executor binding REST route or qualified production callback exists. Hosted/remote executor sources refuse.

features.name: Data owner stays separate from native authority
features.description: Workflow checks Store/native profile equality, and refuses saved executor/thread_owner metadata until a qualified binding exists; data membership alone cannot start cross-owner native edits.
limits: Shared/cross-profile Address, native results and exact Stop routing are not qualified. Do not confuse shared data CRUD with independently selected executor support.

features.name: Current and future profile default policy
features.description: A pure desktop-default policy enables unset choices unless restricted while preserving explicit opt-out; capabilities separately report missing automatic local-profile backend lifecycle support.
limits: Partial/requested outcome: no current/future-profile install/enable lifecycle implementation or automatic setting writes demonstrated. Pure policy is not availability acceptance.

features.name: Standalone frontend sharing seams not mounted
features.description: A scoped client and profile/member/move/executor components exist, but no production frontend importer or built bundle mount was found in either captured candidate.
limits: Partial, not operational sharing UI. Owner supplies navigation/draft hooks, an authenticated roster and executor bridge; shared-root capability remains false. Component source is not installed as separate frontend files and sharing symbols are absent from the installed bundle.

features.name: Shared-space interchange and project backup boundary
features.description: Current file import/export and full-backup routes always select the private owner Store; the shared service has no route for importing/exporting/restoring a shared project or its membership catalog.
limits: Partial shared-space parity: canonical Store backup can represent content through trusted Python composition, but shared membership metadata and shared REST interchange are not wired. No claim that private backup protects every project.

features.name: Standalone agent and dashboard entrypoints
features.description: Plugin manifest declares workspace_apply/hooks and local conversion dependencies; agent __init__ registers the tool/hooks, dashboard manifest mounts the API, and API module namespace is installation-rooted.
limits: Plugin source registration is not proof that current or future profile backends/desktop halves are enabled. No Hermes core changes or centrally operated service are required by this data model.

features.name: Host-owned authentication and profile routing
features.description: REST router depends on Hermes token admission and resolves selected home inside each request. Native workflow principals are host-owned and the HTTP command allowlist excludes raw run/bind authority.
limits: Host/private module compatibility and live authentication were not exercised; this is source wiring, not an independent security assessment.

features.name: Source/profile/dataset-bound draft buffers
features.description: Public plugin storage retains content, title, property and discussion drafts keyed by connection, profile, dataset scope and item, with property-column identity and token-based acknowledgement.
limits: Recovery buffers are separate from authoritative SQLite and are not part of complete Store backup. Opening a draft does not write it to the server. No encryption or retention guarantee inferred from the storage API.

features.name: Owner-fenced REST write queue
features.description: The state client captures the source/profile owner, serialises ordinary commands and transfers, injects current scope/revision and refuses stale replies after owner/dataset changes.
limits: An in-memory state/write queue, not offline synchronisation or a durable operation log. Reads still load full /state.

features.name: Navigation preference stored outside documents
features.description: Navigation width uses public plugin storage under a connection/profile key, independent from document content and SQLite backups.
limits: This records storage semantics only; UI resizing is inventoried elsewhere. Preference is not dataset/page-specific and is not included in Store backup.

features.name: Page-local document-width preference
features.description: Local Boolean document-width preference is keyed by connection, profile, dataset scope and item, separate from prose, versions and native grants; the current installed generated bundle now includes its implementation.
limits: Previous installed-absent limitation is superseded by current frozen package. Source presence is not observed persistence.
This SDK preference is not canonical SQLite content, template data or complete Store backup. Missing/failed read defaults false; only explicit true enables wide.
